newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boise Cascade Office raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boise Cascade Office raised.

text.p: -- Dean Witter Reynolds said it raised its rating on Boise Cascade Office Products Inc to buy from neutral based on a better outlook and valuation for the office products company.

-- Boise Cascade Office's stock is inexpensive, trading at less than 16 times estimated 1997 earnings of $1.15 a share, Dean Witter analyst Patrick McCormack said in a report. Earnings are expected to improve, benefitting from easing paper prices and contributions from recent acquisitions, he said. In addition, the pace of acquisitions by Boise Cascade Office could pick up, he added.
-- Shares of Boise Cascade Office are trading up one to 18-5/8.
